summary: The page exhibits visual collision where the floating chapter dock overlaps body copy without sufficient clearance or blur occlusion.

issues.title: Content overlap with floating dock
issues.description: Body text runs directly beneath the floating chapter indicator without adequate padding or scrim separation.
issues.evidence: The third paragraph text collides directly with 'Chapter 3 of 9' navigation text.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom padding in the reading card or apply an atmosphere scrim mask.
